items.q: Is the report ready to send to a client?
items.a: Yes, after you check the numbers and add your notes. The insights are a starting point that you should confirm and personalise.

items.q: What should a monthly SEO report include?
items.a: Clicks, impressions, CTR and average position from Search Console, the top pages and queries, what changed this month and the plan for next month.

items.q: Is the monthly SEO report maker free?
items.a: Yes. The monthly SEO report maker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Can you handle SEO reporting for my business?
items.a: Yes. Our SEO team sends a plain-language monthly report from your own Search Console and GA4.
